# War Scroll Column 1 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 1 | **Condition:** complete

---

**1:1** For the Instructor, the rule of the war. The first engagement of the Sons of Light shall be against the lot of the Sons of Darkness, against the army of Belial, against the troop of Edom and Moab and the sons of Ammon,

**1:2** and the army of the inhabitants of Philistia, and against the troops of the Kittim of Asshur, and with them those who violate the covenant — allies in wickedness.

**1:3** The sons of Levi, the sons of Judah, and the sons of Benjamin, the exiles of the wilderness, shall wage war against them with [...] against all their troops, when the exiles of the Sons of Light return from the Wilderness of the Peoples

**1:4** to encamp in the Wilderness of Jerusalem. And after the war they shall go up from there [...] against the Kittim of Egypt.

**1:5** And in his time he shall go forth with great wrath to wage war against the kings of the north, and his anger shall seek to destroy and to cut off the horn of

**1:6** [his enemies. This] shall be a time of salvation for the people of God, and an appointed time of dominion for all the men of his lot, and of everlasting destruction for all the lot of Belial.

**1:7** And there shall be great panic among the sons of Japheth, and Asshur shall fall with none to help him. And the dominion of the Kittim shall cease, so that wickedness shall be subdued without

**1:8** any remnant, and there shall be no survivor among the Sons of Darkness.

**1:9** And the Sons of Righteousness shall shine to all the ends of the world, continuing to shine until all the appointed times of darkness are brought to an end. And in the appointed time of God, his exalted greatness shall shine

**1:10** for all the ages of eternity — peace and blessing, glory and joy, and length of days for all the Sons of Light. And on the day the Kittim fall, there shall be a battle and terrible destruction

**1:11** before the God of Israel, for that shall be the day appointed by him from of old for the war of annihilation against the Sons of Darkness. On that day the congregation of the divine beings

**1:12** and the assembly of men shall engage one another in great destruction. The Sons of Light and the lot of Darkness shall fight together for the power of God,

**1:13** amid the shout of a great multitude and the war cry of divine beings and of men, on the day of calamity. It shall be a time of distress for all the people redeemed by God.

**1:14** And of all their afflictions none shall be like this one, from its onset until eternal redemption is complete. And on the day of their battle against the Kittim, they shall go forth

**1:15** to war. In three lots the Sons of Light shall stand firm to strike down wickedness, and in three lots the army of Belial shall brace themselves to force back the lot of [...]

**1:16** The infantry columns shall cause hearts to melt, but the power of God shall strengthen the heart of the Sons of Light. And in the seventh lot, the great hand of God shall subdue

**1:17** Belial and all the angels of his dominion, and all the men of his lot shall suffer everlasting destruction.

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence translation from the Hebrew of 1QM Column 1. Preserves sentence structure and sectarian terminology. "Kittim" retained as the scroll's cipher for a foreign imperial power (most likely Rome). The column provides a programmatic overview of the eschatological war, culminating in a seven-engagement battle with divine intervention in the final round.*
